GameplayDescription: ['Margaret unleashes a high-damage beam at the designated target.', 'Margaret summons a mirage clone to launch a series of high-damage attacks.']

['When Ezette is attacked, a Matrix counterattack is triggered. Dodge to evade it.', 'After charging up, Ezette unleashes a series of attacks on targets in the area. Be ready to Dodge.', 'Ezette hurls a rock at the target. Counter with Parry or Dodge.']

['When Powered is attacked, a Matrix counterattack is triggered. Dodge to evade it.', 'Powered charges on the spot, releasing an electromagnetic pulse. Upon hitting the target, it will be stunned and knocked back.', 'After two consecutive parries against Powered, it leaps up and unleashes the Giant Drill. Counter with a Parry or Dodge.']
["When Fu Shen's sweep connects, he grabs the target and deals heavy damage. Counter with Parry or Dodge.", 'Fu Shen charges up, then lunges to grab the target. Dodge to counter it.']
